name: RoundTripCodeEval (RTCE)
description: LLMs demonstrate strong performance on code benchmarks, yet consistent reasoning across forward and backward execution remains elusive. We present RoundTripCodeEval (RTCE), a benchmark of four code execution reasoning tasks that evaluates round-trip consistency through execution-free, exact-match assessment of bijection fidelity across four lossless compression algorithms. We evaluate state-of-the-art Code-LLMs under zero-shot prompting, supervised fine-tuning on execution traces, and iterative self-reflection.
